post_hoc: [MEASURE] POST-HOC (2026-10-29): replay of the released eICU primary arm to recompute (1) the BBSE-implied answered positive fraction with the head's S_train prior (audit BBSE-1, contract C1) and (2) the exact S_aux atom-unit certification margin beside the released record-pooled feasibility proxy (audit CORE-3). Nothing here is a certified quantity; no certificate, threshold, guarantee or registered prediction descends from it, and the released artifacts are unchanged.

estimands.bbse_released: released formula: mean over the answered set of p_t = o_t/(1+o_t), o_t = rho_point * odds_head(x); divides out the S_aux prior pi_s
estimands.bbse_corrected: fixed explain.composition (contract C1): o_t = rho_point * odds(clip(pi_s, PI_CLIP, 1-PI_CLIP)) / odds(pi_train) * odds_head(x), pi_train = train.y.mean() = the S_train record prevalence the head's odds carry
estimands.margin_atom: exact S_aux atom-unit margin max_tau (alpha - mean_c Z_c(tau)), Z_c = influence_atoms(score_aux, err_aux, ...) over all aux.n_sites columns; argmax = walk_order(atoms)[0]
estimands.margin_atom_answered: the same maximum restricted to thresholds with S_aux coverage > 0, the domain the proxy uses; where nothing answers every atom is alpha and the margin is exactly 0
estimands.margin_proxy: released diagnostic.feasibility margin = pipeline._feasibility: max_tau cov(tau) * (alpha - risk(tau)) * mean_c min(n_c, M)/M, cov and risk pooled over S_aux records
estimands.floor: margin_floor(n_cal_carrying, DELTA, alpha) = ln(1/DELTA)(1-alpha)/n, the information floor in atom units at the record-carrying calibration count; a first-order heuristic, not an impossibility bound
